```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library("DNABarcodes")
library("Biostrings") 
```

```{r}
##First designing U6p-pegRNAs targeting other sites (HBB, FANCF, EMX1, CLYBL1 and HEK3 control)

set.seed(5)

##First get top 5 promoters 

U6 <- read_csv("/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/U6_promoters_by_element/Revision_Oligo_Design/U6_Edit_Scores_Comparison_Table.csv")

Top_U6_Promoters <- U6 %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(Median_Human_Edit_Score = median(K562:iPSC))

Top_U6_Promoters <- Top_U6_Promoters %>% 
  arrange(-Median_Human_Edit_Score) %>% 
  head(5) %>% 
  select(Name, U6_Promoter_Seq, U6_Median_Human_Edit_Score = Median_Human_Edit_Score)

##Then select another 5 that had a broad range of activity levels in both the primary screen and subu6 validation screen (edit scores of approx. 0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10)

SubU6 <- read_csv("/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/Figs/Pub_Figs/FigS5_Final_Figure_Datasets/SubU6_Edit_Stats.csv")

ggplot(SubU6, aes(x = Recloned_Subset_Mean_iPSC_BC_Normalized_Edit_Score)) +   geom_histogram()

ggplot(SubU6, aes(x = log2(Recloned_Subset_Mean_iPSC_BC_Normalized_Edit_Score))) +   geom_histogram()

SubU6_Subset <- SubU6 %>% 
  filter(Name %in% c("Callorhinchus_milii_RNU6-8_ENSCMIG00000009578", "SynU61-2", "Scleropages_formosus_RNU6-8_ENSSFOG00015026611",   "Numida_meleagris_RNU6-2_ENSNMEG00000003235", "Weissman_bU6-2"))

ggplot(SubU6_Subset, aes(x = log2(Recloned_Subset_Mean_iPSC_BC_Normalized_Edit_Score), y = log2(Primary_Screen_Mean_Barcode_Normalized_iPSC_Edit_Score))) + geom_point()

##Add to selection of top U6 promoters

U6 <- read_csv("/Users/troymcdiarmid/Downloads/U6_Edit_Scores_Comparison_Table.csv")

SubU6_Subset <- U6 %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(Median_Human_Edit_Score = median(K562:iPSC))

SubU6_Subset <- SubU6_Subset %>% 
  arrange(-Median_Human_Edit_Score) %>% 
  filter(Name %in% c("Callorhinchus_milii_RNU6-8_ENSCMIG00000009578", "SynU61-2", "Scleropages_formosus_RNU6-8_ENSSFOG00015026611",   "Numida_meleagris_RNU6-2_ENSNMEG00000003235", "Weissman_bU6-2")) %>% 
  select(Name, U6_Promoter_Seq, U6_Median_Human_Edit_Score = Median_Human_Edit_Score)

Top_U6_Promoters <- rbind(Top_U6_Promoters, SubU6_Subset) %>% 
  type_convert() 

##Then get 10 promoters from the Zoonomia screen. Top 3, 2 others better than hNRU6-1p and 5 from a broad range (Top 3, log2 1, 0.5, -0.5, -1, -2, -4, -8)

Zoonomia_PolIII_Pro <- read_csv("/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/U6_promoters_by_element/Revision_Oligo_Design/Pol_III_Pro_Edit_Scores_Class.csv")

Zoonomia_PolIII_Pro_Select <- Zoonomia_PolIII_Pro %>% 
  filter(Seq_Name %in% c(">7SK__fullTreeAnc55__fullTreeAnc55refChr9856:2250-2505()_BC_1", ">RNU6_7__fullTreeAnc5_20240405.fa__fullTreeAnc5refChr25893:5-307()_RC_BC_1", ">U6__fullTreeAnc160__fullTreeAnc160refChr2759:1886336-1886574()_RC_BC_2", ">U6__Giraffa_tippelskirchi__LVKQ01S008640.1:139024-139253()_BC_3", ">U6__Monodon_monoceros__MonMon_M_scaffold_3174:19301-19535()_BC_3", ">U6__fullTreeAnc75__fullTreeAnc75refChr7633:112983-113215()_BC_1", ">RNU6_7__fullTreeAnc238_20240405.fa__fullTreeAnc238refChr9145:10311-10610()_RC_BC_1", ">RNU6_8__Cercocebus_atys_20240405.fa__KQ010217.1:2346502-2346810()_BC_1", ">RNU6_9__Delphinapterus_leucas_20240405.fa__KZ290250.1:506585-506983()_BC_1", ">RNU6_9__Tonatia_saurophila_20240405.fa__TonSau_scaffold_9071:22929-23315()_BC_3"))

Zoonomia_PolIII_Pro_Select_F <- Zoonomia_PolIII_Pro_Select %>% 
  distinct(Pro_Seq, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  select(Name = Seq_Name, U6_Promoter_Seq = Pro_Seq, U6_Median_Human_Edit_Score = Grand_Mean_BC_Normalized_Edit_Score) 

##Bind them together

Top_U6_Promoters <- rbind(Top_U6_Promoters, Zoonomia_PolIII_Pro_Select_F) %>% 
  type_convert() 

##Then get EMX1 and FANCF spacers, RTT, PBS, etc. from Table S6 from Koeppel et al., 2024 NBT (https://www.nature.com/articles/s41587-023-01678-y#Sec33)

Koeppel_pegRNAs <- read_csv("/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/U6_promoters_by_element/Revision_Oligo_Design/41587_2023_1678_MOESM3_ESM.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(1:7)

##Recreate the HEK3 targeting constructs for control 

Top_U6_Promoters_TOI <- Top_U6_Promoters 

Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$F_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GACGGGGAATTAACC"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Five_Prime_Restriction <- "TAGTGAGGTCTCGGTGC"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Target <- "HEK3"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Spacer <- "GGCCCAGACTGAGCACGTGA"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Scaffold <-  "GTTTTAGAGCTAGAAATAGCAAGTTAAAATAAGGCTAGTCCGTTATCAACTTGAAAAAGTGGGACCGAGTCGGTCC"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Homology_Arm <- "TCTGCCATCA"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$PBS <- "CGTGCTCAGTCTG"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Partial_Term <- "TTTT"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Three_Prime_Restriction <- "TGAGACCTCCCTA"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$R_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GCTTACGGGCAACAT"

Top_U6_Promoters_HEK3 <- Top_U6_Promoters_TOI


##Create the HBB targeting constructs based on predict2.0 output and Adamson lab PE7 paper Table S7 

Top_U6_Promoters_TOI <- Top_U6_Promoters 

Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$F_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GACGGGGAATTAACC"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Five_Prime_Restriction <- "TAGTGAGGTCTCGGTGC"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Target <- "HBB"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Spacer <- "GCATGGTGCACCTGACTCCTG"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Scaffold <-  "GTTTTAGAGCTAGAAATAGCAAGTTAAAATAAGGCTAGTCCGTTATCAACTTGAAAAAGTGGGACCGAGTCGGTCC"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Homology_Arm <- "AGACTTCTCCTCAG"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$PBS <- "GAGTCAGGTGCACCA"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Partial_Term <- "TTTT"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Three_Prime_Restriction <- "TGAGACCTCCCTA"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$R_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GCTTACGGGCAACAT"

Top_U6_Promoters_HBB <- Top_U6_Promoters_TOI

##Create the CLYBL targeting constructs

pegRNA_TOI <- Koeppel_pegRNAs %>% 
  filter(target == "CLYBL")

Top_U6_Promoters_TOI <- Top_U6_Promoters 

Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$F_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GACGGGGAATTAACC"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Five_Prime_Restriction <- "TAGTGAGGTCTCGGTGC"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Target <- pegRNA_TOI$target
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Spacer <- pegRNA_TOI$spacer
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Scaffold <- "GTTTTAGAGCTAGAAATAGCAAGTTAAAATAAGGCTAGTCCGTTATCAACTTGAAAAAGTGGGACCGAGTCGGTCC"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Homology_Arm <- pegRNA_TOI$ha
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$PBS <- pegRNA_TOI$pbs
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Partial_Term <- "TTTT"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Three_Prime_Restriction <- "TGAGACCTCCCTA"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$R_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GCTTACGGGCAACAT"

Top_U6_Promoters_CLYBL <- Top_U6_Promoters_TOI

##Create the FANCF targeting constructs - note the FANCF homology arm was shortened to avoid a BsbI site present in the long Koeppel construct

pegRNA_TOI <- Koeppel_pegRNAs %>% 
  filter(target == "FANCF")

Top_U6_Promoters_TOI <- Top_U6_Promoters 

Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$F_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GACGGGGAATTAACC"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Five_Prime_Restriction <- "TAGTGAGGTCTCGGTGC"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Target <- pegRNA_TOI$target
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Spacer <- pegRNA_TOI$spacer
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Scaffold <- "GTTTTAGAGCTAGAAATAGCAAGTTAAAATAAGGCTAGTCCGTTATCAACTTGAAAAAGTGGGACCGAGTCGGTCC"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Homology_Arm <- "GGAAAAGCGATCCAGGT"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$PBS <- pegRNA_TOI$pbs
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Partial_Term <- "TTTT"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Three_Prime_Restriction <- "TGAGACCTCCCTA"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$R_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GCTTACGGGCAACAT"

Top_U6_Promoters_FANCF <- Top_U6_Promoters_TOI


##Create the EMX1 targeting constructs

pegRNA_TOI <- Koeppel_pegRNAs %>% 
  filter(target == "EMX1")

Top_U6_Promoters_TOI <- Top_U6_Promoters 

Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$F_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GACGGGGAATTAACC"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Five_Prime_Restriction <- "TAGTGAGGTCTCGGTGC"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Target <- pegRNA_TOI$target
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Spacer <- pegRNA_TOI$spacer
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Scaffold <- "GTTTTAGAGCTAGAAATAGCAAGTTAAAATAAGGCTAGTCCGTTATCAACTTGAAAAAGTGGGACCGAGTCGGTCC"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Homology_Arm <- pegRNA_TOI$ha
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$PBS <- pegRNA_TOI$pbs
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Partial_Term <- "TTTT"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$Three_Prime_Restriction <- "TGAGACCTCCCTA"
Top_U6_Promoters_TOI$R_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GCTTACGGGCAACAT"

Top_U6_Promoters_EMX1 <- Top_U6_Promoters_TOI

##Bind them all together

Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F <- rbind(Top_U6_Promoters_HEK3, Top_U6_Promoters_HBB, Top_U6_Promoters_CLYBL, Top_U6_Promoters_EMX1, Top_U6_Promoters_FANCF)


##Adding the barcodes 

Top_8N_BCs <- read_csv("/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/U6_promoters_by_element/Revision_Oligo_Design/Pooled_Edit_Scores.csv") %>% 
  filter(Edit_Score > 0.5) %>% 
  filter(!(grepl("GGTCTC", pBC_Seq))) %>%
  filter(!(grepl("GAGACC", pBC_Seq))) %>% 
  filter(!(grepl("GGTC", pBC_Seq))) %>%
  filter(!(grepl("GAGA", pBC_Seq))) %>% 
  sample_n(3*(length(Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F$U6_Promoter_Seq)))

##Replicate the set of sequences 3 times for each barcode and add labels 

Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F_BC1 <- Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F
Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F_BC1$BC_Number <- "BC_1"

Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F_BC2 <- Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F
Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F_BC2$BC_Number <- "BC_2"

Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F_BC3 <- Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F
Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F_BC3$BC_Number <- "BC_3"

Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F <- rbind(Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F_BC1, Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F_BC2, Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F_BC3)

Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F <- Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F %>% 
  unite(Seq_Name, Name, Target, BC_Number, remove = FALSE)

##Add the barcodes

Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F$BC_8N <- Top_8N_BCs$pBC_Seq

##Uniting to make full oligo sequence with restriction sites to order

Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F <- Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F %>% 
  unite(U6p_pegRNA_BC, U6_Promoter_Seq, Spacer, Scaffold, Homology_Arm, BC_8N, PBS, Partial_Term, sep = "", remove = FALSE) %>% 
  unite(Full_RS_U6p_pegRNA_RS_Seq, F_Dial_Out_Primer, Five_Prime_Restriction, U6_Promoter_Seq, Spacer, Scaffold, Homology_Arm, BC_8N, PBS, Partial_Term, Three_Prime_Restriction, R_Dial_Out_Primer, sep = "", remove = FALSE) 

##Make relevant DNA columns upper case
  Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F <- Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F %>% 
    mutate(U6p_pegRNA_BC = str_to_upper(U6p_pegRNA_BC)) %>% 
    mutate(Full_RS_U6p_pegRNA_RS_Seq = str_to_upper(Full_RS_U6p_pegRNA_RS_Seq))
  
##Calculate promoter and total oligo sequence length
  
Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F <- Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F %>% 
  mutate(Pro_Seq_Length = str_length(U6_Promoter_Seq)) %>% 
  mutate(U6p_pegRNA_BC_Length = str_length(U6p_pegRNA_BC)) %>% 
  mutate(Full_RS_U6p_pegRNA_RS_Seq_Length = str_length(Full_RS_U6p_pegRNA_RS_Seq)) 

##Reorder and rename columns for consistency

Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F <- Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F %>%
  select(Seq_Name, Pro_Seq_Name = Name, Target, BC_Number, F_Dial_Out_Primer, Five_Prime_Restriction,  Pro_Seq = U6_Promoter_Seq, Spacer, Scaffold, Homology_Arm, pBC_Seq = BC_8N, PBS, Partial_Term, Three_Prime_Restriction, R_Dial_Out_Primer, U6p_pegRNA_BC, U6_Median_Human_Edit_Score, Pro_Seq_Length, U6p_pegRNA_BC_Length, Full_RS_U6p_pegRNA_RS_Seq_Length, Full_RS_U6p_pegRNA_RS_Seq)
  
##See how many of the sequences have restriction sites and change them 

Forward_RS_Check <- Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F %>% 
  filter((grepl("GGTCTC", U6p_pegRNA_BC))) 
  
Reverse_RS_Check <- Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F %>% 
  filter((grepl("GAGACC", U6p_pegRNA_BC)))  

##None - we're good! 

##Check relative edit scores

ggplot(Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F, aes(x = log2(U6_Median_Human_Edit_Score), y = log2(U6_Median_Human_Edit_Score))) + geom_point()

ggplot(Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F, aes(x = U6_Median_Human_Edit_Score, y = U6_Median_Human_Edit_Score)) + geom_point()

##Add a unique numbering column

Twist_Order_Sheet_U6p_Alt_Target <- Top_U6_Promoters_Alt_Target_F %>% 
  mutate(ID_Number = row_number())

##Write it as a file by element

write_csv(Twist_Order_Sheet_U6p_Alt_Target, "/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/U6_promoters_by_element/Revision_Oligo_Design/241230_U6p_Alt_Target_By_Element.csv")

##Write as .csv in Twist order format

Twist_Order_Sheet_U6p_Alt_Target <- Twist_Order_Sheet_U6p_Alt_Target %>% 
  select(`gene name` = ID_Number, FASTA_Seq = Full_RS_U6p_pegRNA_RS_Seq)

write_csv(Twist_Order_Sheet_U6p_Alt_Target, "/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/U6_promoters_by_element/Revision_Oligo_Design/241230_U6p_Alt_Target_Twist_Order_Sheet.csv")


```



```{r}

set.seed(4)

##Designing pegRNAs to target the alternate sites

BB <- read_csv("/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/U6_promoters_by_element/Revision_Oligo_Design/BB_Edit_Scores_Comparison_Table.csv") %>% 
  filter(BC_Pool == 1)

BB <- BB %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(Median_Human_Edit_Score = median(K562:iPSC))


##Recreate the HEK targeting constructs for control (only doing standard human RNU6-1p for HEK3 for control)

BB_TOI <- BB 

BB_TOI$F_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GACGGGGAATTAACC"
BB_TOI$Five_Prime_Restriction <- "TAGTGAGGTCTCGCACC"
BB_TOI$Target <- "HEK3"
BB_TOI$Spacer <- "GGCCCAGACTGAGCACGTGA"
BB_TOI$Homology_Arm <- "TCTGCCATCA"
BB_TOI$PBS <- "CGTGCTCAGTCTG"
BB_TOI$Partial_Term <- "TTTT"
BB_TOI$Three_Prime_Restriction <- "TGAGACCTCCCTA"
BB_TOI$R_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GCTTACGGGCAACAT"

BB_HEK3 <- BB_TOI

##Create the HBB targeting constructs 

BB_TOI <- BB 

BB_TOI$F_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GACGGGGAATTAACC"
BB_TOI$Five_Prime_Restriction <- "TAGTGAGGTCTCGCACC"
BB_TOI$Target <- "HBB"
BB_TOI$Spacer <- "GCATGGTGCACCTGACTCCTG"
BB_TOI$Homology_Arm <- "AGACTTCTCCTCAG"
BB_TOI$PBS <- "GAGTCAGGTGCACCA"
BB_TOI$Partial_Term <- "TTTT"
BB_TOI$Three_Prime_Restriction <- "TGAGACCTCCCTA"
BB_TOI$R_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GCTTACGGGCAACAT"

BB_HBB <- BB_TOI

##Create the CYLBL targeting constructs

pegRNA_TOI <- Koeppel_pegRNAs %>% 
  filter(target == "CLYBL")

BB_TOI <- BB 

BB_TOI$F_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GACGGGGAATTAACC"
BB_TOI$Five_Prime_Restriction <- "TAGTGAGGTCTCGCACC"
BB_TOI$Target <- pegRNA_TOI$target
BB_TOI$Spacer <- pegRNA_TOI$spacer
BB_TOI$Homology_Arm <- pegRNA_TOI$ha
BB_TOI$PBS <- pegRNA_TOI$pbs
BB_TOI$Partial_Term <- "TTTT"
BB_TOI$Three_Prime_Restriction <- "TGAGACCTCCCTA"
BB_TOI$R_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GCTTACGGGCAACAT"

BB_CLYBL <- BB_TOI

##Create the FANCF targeting constructs - note the FANCF homology arm was shortened to avoid a BsbI site present in the long Koeppel construct

pegRNA_TOI <- Koeppel_pegRNAs %>% 
  filter(target == "FANCF")

BB_TOI <- BB 

BB_TOI$F_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GACGGGGAATTAACC"
BB_TOI$Five_Prime_Restriction <- "TAGTGAGGTCTCGCACC"
BB_TOI$Target <- pegRNA_TOI$target
BB_TOI$Spacer <- pegRNA_TOI$spacer
BB_TOI$Homology_Arm <- "GGAAAAGCGATCCAGGT"
BB_TOI$PBS <- pegRNA_TOI$pbs
BB_TOI$Partial_Term <- "TTTT"
BB_TOI$Three_Prime_Restriction <- "TGAGACCTCCCTA"
BB_TOI$R_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GCTTACGGGCAACAT"

BB_FANCF <- BB_TOI


##Create the EMX1 targeting constructs

pegRNA_TOI <- Koeppel_pegRNAs %>% 
  filter(target == "EMX1")

BB_TOI <- BB 

BB_TOI$F_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GACGGGGAATTAACC"
BB_TOI$Five_Prime_Restriction <- "TAGTGAGGTCTCGCACC"
BB_TOI$Target <- pegRNA_TOI$target
BB_TOI$Spacer <- pegRNA_TOI$spacer
BB_TOI$Homology_Arm <- pegRNA_TOI$ha
BB_TOI$PBS <- pegRNA_TOI$pbs
BB_TOI$Partial_Term <- "TTTT"
BB_TOI$Three_Prime_Restriction <- "TGAGACCTCCCTA"
BB_TOI$R_Dial_Out_Primer <- "GCTTACGGGCAACAT"

BB_EMX1 <- BB_TOI

##Bind both together

BB_Alt_Target_F <- rbind(BB_HEK3, BB_HBB, BB_CLYBL, BB_EMX1, BB_FANCF)

##Adding the barcodes 

Top_8N_BCs <- read_csv("/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/U6_promoters_by_element/Revision_Oligo_Design/Pooled_Edit_Scores.csv") %>% 
  filter(Edit_Score > 0.5) %>% 
  filter(!(grepl("GGTCTC", pBC_Seq))) %>%
  filter(!(grepl("GAGACC", pBC_Seq))) %>% 
  filter(!(grepl("GGTC", pBC_Seq))) %>%
  filter(!(grepl("GAGA", pBC_Seq))) %>% 
  filter(!(grepl("CTC", pBC_Seq))) %>%
  sample_n(3*(length(BB_Alt_Target_F$Backbone_Seq)))

##Replicate the set of sequences 3 times for each barcode and add labels 

BB_Alt_Target_F_BC1 <- BB_Alt_Target_F
BB_Alt_Target_F_BC1$BC_Number <- "BC_1"

BB_Alt_Target_F_BC2 <- BB_Alt_Target_F
BB_Alt_Target_F_BC2$BC_Number <- "BC_2"

BB_Alt_Target_F_BC3 <- BB_Alt_Target_F
BB_Alt_Target_F_BC3$BC_Number <- "BC_3"

BB_Alt_Target_F <- rbind(BB_Alt_Target_F_BC1, BB_Alt_Target_F_BC2, BB_Alt_Target_F_BC3)

BB_Alt_Target_F <- BB_Alt_Target_F %>% 
  unite(Seq_Name, Oligo_Number, Target, BC_Number, remove = FALSE)

##Add the barcodes

BB_Alt_Target_F$BC_8N <- Top_8N_BCs$pBC_Seq

##Uniting to make full oligo sequence with restriction sites to order

BB_Alt_Target_F <- BB_Alt_Target_F %>% 
  unite(pegRNA_BC, Spacer, Backbone_Seq, Homology_Arm, BC_8N, PBS, Partial_Term, sep = "", remove = FALSE) %>% 
  unite(RS_pegRNA_RS_Seq, Five_Prime_Restriction, Spacer, Backbone_Seq, Homology_Arm, BC_8N, PBS, Partial_Term, Three_Prime_Restriction, sep = "", remove = FALSE)

##Add a random sequence to all sequences to make them all longer than the 258 cut off then chop em down to be the same length (stuffer sequence of 300bp from c-terminal end of eGFP with not common restriction sites)

BB_Alt_Target_F$Stuffer_GFP_Seq <- "" 

BB_Alt_Target_F <- BB_Alt_Target_F %>% 
  mutate(Stuffer_GFP_Seq = str_to_upper(Stuffer_GFP_Seq))

BB_Alt_Target_F <- BB_Alt_Target_F %>% 
  unite(Full_Stuffer_RS_pegRNA8N_RS_Seq, Stuffer_GFP_Seq, RS_pegRNA_RS_Seq, sep = "", remove = FALSE)

##Calculate full seq length and chop down

BB_Alt_Target_F <- BB_Alt_Target_F %>% 
  mutate(Seq_Length = str_length(Full_Stuffer_RS_pegRNA8N_RS_Seq))

ggplot(BB_Alt_Target_F, aes(x = Seq_Length)) + 
  geom_histogram()

##Chop down sequences

BB_Alt_Target_F <- BB_Alt_Target_F %>% 
  separate(Full_Stuffer_RS_pegRNA8N_RS_Seq, into = c("Five_Prime_Cutoff", "Full_Stuffer_RS_pegRNA8N_RS_Seq"), sep = -205)

BB_Alt_Target_F <- BB_Alt_Target_F %>%
  mutate(Seq_Length = str_length(Full_Stuffer_RS_pegRNA8N_RS_Seq)) %>% 
  select(!Five_Prime_Cutoff)


ggplot(BB_Alt_Target_F, aes(x = Seq_Length)) + 
  geom_histogram() 


##Unite to make full final oligo sequences

BB_Alt_Target_F <- BB_Alt_Target_F %>% 
  unite(Full_RS_pegRNA_RS_Seq, F_Dial_Out_Primer, Full_Stuffer_RS_pegRNA8N_RS_Seq, R_Dial_Out_Primer, sep = "", remove = FALSE) 

##Make relevant DNA columns upper case
  BB_Alt_Target_F <- BB_Alt_Target_F %>%
```

```{r}
set.seed(6)

##Make more pegRNA variants with A-U flip included 

##Start with scaffold sequences to mutate 

##A-U flip pegRNA

"GTTTAAGAGCTAGAAATAGCAAGTTTAAATAAGGCTAGTCCGTTATCAACTTGAAAAAGTGGGACCGAGTCGGTCC"


##Function to generate all SNVs or deletions accross a sequence 

mutate_sequence <- function(string, num = 1, nucleotides = c("A","T","C","G","_")) {
  l_str <- str_length(string)

  choices <- cross(list(
    cols = combn(seq_len(l_str), num, simplify = F),
    muts = cross(rerun(num, nucleotides)) %>% map(unlist)
  ))

  choice_matrix <- 
    map_dfr(choices, as_tibble, .id = "rows") %>% 
    mutate(rows = as.numeric(rows))

  seq_matrix <- str_split(rep(string, max(choice_matrix$rows)), "", simplify = T)

  seq_matrix[as.matrix(choice_matrix[,1:2])] <- str_to_lower(choice_matrix$muts)
  apply(seq_matrix, 1, paste, collapse = "")
}

##Specific example

mutate_sequence("ATCG", num = 1)

  mutate(RAR_AC_Seq = str_to_upper(RAR_Seq)) %>%
```

```{r}

set.seed(1)

##Creating saturation mutagenesis library of full length hRNU6-1p

##Create saturation mutagenesis of H1 and 7SK promoters 

##Function to generate all SNVs or deletions accross a sequence 

mutate_sequence <- function(string, num = 1, nucleotides = c("A","T","C","G","_")) {
  l_str <- str_length(string)

  choices <- cross(list(
    cols = combn(seq_len(l_str), num, simplify = F),
    muts = cross(rerun(num, nucleotides)) %>% map(unlist)
  ))

  choice_matrix <- 
    map_dfr(choices, as_tibble, .id = "rows") %>% 
    mutate(rows = as.numeric(rows))

  seq_matrix <- str_split(rep(string, max(choice_matrix$rows)), "", simplify = T)

  seq_matrix[as.matrix(choice_matrix[,1:2])] <- str_to_lower(choice_matrix$muts)
  apply(seq_matrix, 1, paste, collapse = "")
}

##Specific example

mutate_sequence("ATCG", num = 1) 

##Saturation mutagenesis of the full length U6p_pegRNA cassette
```

```{r}
##Alternative saturation of the minRNU6-1p-pegRNA with 3x 8N iBCS

set.seed(1)

##Creating saturation mutagenesis library of full length hRNU6-1p

##Create saturation mutagenesis of H1 and 7SK promoters 

##Function to generate all SNVs or deletions accross a sequence 

mutate_sequence <- function(string, num = 1, nucleotides = c("A","T","C","G","_")) {
  l_str <- str_length(string)

  choices <- cross(list(
    cols = combn(seq_len(l_str), num, simplify = F),
    muts = cross(rerun(num, nucleotides)) %>% map(unlist)
  ))

  choice_matrix <- 
    map_dfr(choices, as_tibble, .id = "rows") %>% 
    mutate(rows = as.numeric(rows))

  seq_matrix <- str_split(rep(string, max(choice_matrix$rows)), "", simplify = T)

  seq_matrix[as.matrix(choice_matrix[,1:2])] <- str_to_lower(choice_matrix$muts)
  apply(seq_matrix, 1, paste, collapse = "")
}

##Specific example

mutate_sequence("ATCG", num = 1) 

##Saturation mutagenesis of the full length U6p_pegRNA cassette 

U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs <- mutate_sequence("GAGGGCCTATTTCCCATGATTCCTTCATATTTGCATATACGATAGCTTACCGTAACTTGAAAGTATTTCGATTTCTTGGCTTTATATATCTTGTGGAAAGGACGAAACACCGGCCCAGACTGAGCACGTGAGTTTTAGAGCTAGAAATAGCAAGTTAAAATAAGGCTAGTCCGTTATCAACTTGAAAAAGTGGGACCGAGTCGGTCCTCTGCCATCAGGTGCCGTGCTCAGTCTG", num = 1) %>% 
  as.data.frame()

names(U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs)[names(U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs) == '.'] <- 'Sequence'

##Change all strings to uppercase and select only unique sequences (i.e. filter out WT replicates)


U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs <-  U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs %>% 
  mutate(Pro_Seq = str_to_upper(Sequence))

##Add a column indicating variant position 

U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs$Variant_Position <- rep(1:str_length(U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs$Pro_Seq), times = 5)

U6p_PegRNA_Standard_Nucleotide <- tibble(x = c("GAGGGCCTATTTCCCATGATTCCTTCATATTTGCATATACGATAGCTTACCGTAACTTGAAAGTATTTCGATTTCTTGGCTTTATATATCTTGTGGAAAGGACGAAACACCGGCCCAGACTGAGCACGTGAGTTTTAGAGCTAGAAATAGCAAGTTAAAATAAGGCTAGTCCGTTATCAACTTGAAAAAGTGGGACCGAGTCGGTCCTCTGCCATCAGGTGCCGTGCTCAGTCTG")) %>% 
  mutate(x = str_to_upper(x)) %>% 
  separate_longer_position(x, width = 1)

U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs$Standard_Nucleotide <- rep(U6p_PegRNA_Standard_Nucleotide$x, times = 5)

U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs$Variant_Nucleotide <- rep(c("A", "T", "C", "G", "Del"), each = str_length(U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs$Pro_Seq))

U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs$FASTA_Arrow <- ">"
U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs$Variant_Arrow <- ">"
U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs$Promoter_Name <- "minhRNU6_1p_pegRNA_Saturation"

U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs <- U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs %>% 
  unite(Seq_Name_1, FASTA_Arrow, Promoter_Name, sep = "") %>% 
  unite(Seq_Name_2, Seq_Name_1, Variant_Position, remove = FALSE) %>% 
  unite(Seq_Name, Seq_Name_2, Standard_Nucleotide, Variant_Arrow, Variant_Nucleotide, sep = "")

##Separate out the spacers, scaffolds, RTT, and PBS by position

U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs <-  U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Full_Seq = Pro_Seq) %>% 
  separate(Full_Seq, into = c("Pro_Seq", "Spacer"), sep = 111, remove = FALSE) %>% 
  separate(Spacer, into = c("Spacer", "Scaffold"), sep = 20) %>% 
  separate(Scaffold, into = c("Scaffold", "RTT"), sep = 76) %>% 
  separate(RTT, into = c("RTT", "5N_iBC"), sep = 10) %>%
  separate(`5N_iBC`, into = c("5N_iBC", "PBS"), sep = 5)

##Filter to remove variants in the iBC 

U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs <-  U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!Variant_Position %in% (218:222))


##Filter for only distinct sequences

U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs <-  U6p_PegRNA_Saturation_Seqs %>%
  distinct(Full_Seq, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(Pro_Seq = str_replace(Pro_Seq, "_", "")) %>% 
  mutate(Spacer = str_replace(Spacer, "_", "")) %>%
  mutate(Scaffold = str_replace(Scaffold, "_", "")) %>%
```
